label: Bible Study
prompt: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a _____: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?
verse: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?
note: John doesn't mince words — loving God while hating your brother doesn't add up.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And Mary said, My soul doth _____ the Lord,
verse: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,
note: Mary's song begins here — her soul makes the Lord bigger in her eyes, the way a magnifying glass does.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done many acts; he slew two lionlike men of Moab: also he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a _____ day.
verse: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done many acts; he slew two lionlike men of Moab: also he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day.
note: Benaiah's legendary résumé: he went down into a pit and slew a lion on a snowy day.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he _____ and knoweth me, that I am the LORD which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, saith the LORD.
verse: But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I am the LORD which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, saith the LORD.
note: Not wisdom, might or riches — the one thing worth boasting about is knowing God.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Seest thou a man _____ in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.
verse: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.
note: See a man 'diligent' in his business? He'll stand before kings — Joseph and Daniel could testify.
